title: When Talk Isn't Code: Comparing LLM Agents That Simulate and Develop Software
title_zh: 当对话不再是代码：比较模拟与开发软件的 LLM 智能体

paragraphs.en: LLMs are used both to simulate network protocol implementations, as honeypots do, and to write them. Prior work evaluates the two uses separately, from a model’s answers or conversations in one case and from its generated code in the other. We observe that a knowledge probe (asking the model which security checks an implementation needs) and a conversation can credit security checks that the generated program lacks, but no study has compared them with the code the same model writes. To fill this gap, we present the first such comparison between simulation mode (S-mode), where the model plays the implementation in a conversation, and development mode (D-mode), where the model writes the program and the program is attacked, with a knowledge probe as a baseline. We design and implement a harness that judges all three with one attack suite and one oracle, and evaluate 15 LLMs on four protocol implementations. We find that with the full security specification, the median model’s attack success is at most 4% on reassembly, HTTP, and firewall implementations in both modes, but 13% in S-mode and 15% in D-mode on DNS. In D-mode, adding the missing DNS requirement to the specification cuts that attack from 100% to 34% and changes only that check, whereas deleting a stated rule weakens the program on other checks too. Asking the model beforehand does not predict which checks a program has, since 13 of the 14 models that write a DNS resolver name the check, yet all 42 programs lack it. S-mode is a useful first filter, flagging 82% of the real DNS vulnerabilities and leaving 96% of the safe cases unflagged. It errs in both directions, over-reporting security checks that D-mode does not implement and under-reporting checks that D-mode does. S-mode can screen but not replace D-mode testing, and security requirements should be written down even when a model can recite them.
paragraphs.zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）既可用于模拟网络协议实现（正如蜜罐所做的那样），也可用于编写这些实现。 先前的研究分别评估了这两种用途：一种情况基于模型的回答或对话，另一种情况则基于其生成的代码。 我们观察到，知识探针（询问模型某项实现需要哪些安全检查）和对话都可以识别出所生成程序缺乏的安全检查，但尚无研究将二者与同一模型编写的代码进行比较。 为了填补这一空白，我们首次对模拟模式（S-mode，即模型在对话中扮演实现角色）与开发模式（D-mode，即模型编写程序并对该程序发起攻击，同时以知识探针作为基准）进行了比较。 我们设计并实现了一个测试框架，使用同一套攻击工具和同一个“神谕”对这三种模式进行评判，并在四种协议实现上评估了15个大型语言模型。 我们发现，在完整的安全规范下，两种模式中模型在重组、HTTP和防火墙实现上的攻击成功率中位数最多为4%，但在DNS实现上，S-mode为13%，D-mode为15%。 在D-mode中，将缺失的DNS要求添加到规范中，可将该攻击的成功率从100%降至34%，且仅影响该项检查；而删除一个已声明的规则，则会使程序在其他检查项上也变得不安全。 事先询问模型无法预测程序具备哪些检查项，因为编写DNS解析器的14个模型中有13个都提到了该项检查，但全部42个程序均未包含它。 S-mode是一个有效的初步筛选方法：它能标记出真实DNS漏洞的82%，同时未标记出96%的安全用例。 该模式在两个方向上都会出错：既会过度报告D-mode未实现的安全检查，也会漏报D-mode实际实现的检查。 S-mode可以辅助筛选，但无法替代D-mode测试；即使模型能够复述安全要求，这些要求仍然应当被明确记录。

paragraphs.en: LLMs are used to simulate network services and to write them. In simulation, a model plays the service in a conversation, as LLM honeypots do when they impersonate a Linux shell or an HTTP service ( Sladić et al., 2024 ; Fan et al., 2024 ; Otal and Canbaz, 2024 ) . In development, coding agents write the program itself ( Jimenez et al., 2024 ; Yang et al., 2024 ; Xia et al., 2025 ) , including network code such as device configurations, protocol logic, and fuzzer inputs ( Wang et al., 2024 ; Meng et al., 2024 ) . Such code can be insecure, since about 40% of 1,689 programs written by GitHub Copilot were vulnerable ( Pearce et al., 2025 ) , and CWEval finds LLM-written code that passes its functional tests but fails its security tests ( Peng et al., 2025 ) .
paragraphs.zh: LLM被用于模拟网络服务以及编写这些服务。 在模拟过程中，模型会在对话中扮演服务的角色，就像LLM蜜罐在冒充Linux外壳或HTTP服务时所做的那样（Sladić等，2024；Fan等，2024；Otal和Canbaz，2024）。 在开发阶段，编码智能体负责编写程序本身（Jimenez等，2024；Yang等，2024；Xia等，2025），包括设备配置、协议逻辑和模糊测试输入等网络代码（Wang等，2024；Meng等，2024）。 这类代码可能存在安全漏洞，因为GitHub Copilot编写的1689个程序中有约40%存在漏洞（Pearce等，2025），而CWEval发现了一些通过功能测试但未通过安全测试的LLM编写代码（Peng等，2025）。

paragraphs.en: Prior work evaluates LLMs on simulating and writing such services in three ways. Knowledge benchmarks test what a model knows about security practice ( Liu, 2023 ; Tihanyi et al., 2024 ) . Studies of simulated services test how convincing and how robust a model is when it plays the service ( Sladić et al., 2024 ; Fan et al., 2024 ; Sladić et al., 2025 ) . Coding-agent benchmarks test the program that a model writes, by building and attacking it ( Jimenez et al., 2024 ; Xia et al., 2025 ) . We call these a knowledge probe , simulation mode (S-mode), and development mode (D-mode). The first two rest on what a model says or does in a conversation, and only D-mode judges the program that ships. To our knowledge, no study checks the first two against the program the same model builds.
paragraphs.zh: 先前的工作通过三种方式评估大型语言模型在模拟和编写此类服务方面的表现。 知识基准测试模型对安全实践的了解程度（Liu, 2023；Tihanyi 等，2024）。 对模拟服务的研究则检验模型在扮演服务时的可信度和稳健性（Sladić 等，2024；Fan 等，2024；Sladić 等，2025）。 编码智能体基准测试通过构建和攻击模型所编写的程序来评估其表现（Jimenez 等，2024；Xia 等，2025）。 我们将这些方法称为知识探针、模拟模式（S-mode）和开发模式（D-mode）。 前两种方法依赖于模型在对话中的言论或行为，而只有开发模式会评估最终交付的程序。 据我们所知，目前还没有研究将前两种方法与同一模型所构建的程序进行对比验证。

In a preliminary experiment on 68 pairs of a model and a check (§ 6 ), we compared the probe and S-mode with the D-mode program. paragraphs.en: Our study. This observation leads to our study, which is, to our knowledge, the first to compare what the same model does when it simulates a network protocol implementation (S-mode) and when it builds one (D-mode), covering where the two agree, where they differ, and why. We keep the probe, which cannot be attacked, as the baseline of Figure 1 . D-mode is our reference because the program is what ships. To make the comparison concrete, we choose network protocol implementations as the target, for three reasons. (i) Their security rules are written down in RFCs ( Mockapetris, 1987 ; Hubert and van Mook, 2009 ; Fielding et al., 2022 ; Ziemba et al., 1995 ) , so we can state a specification and judge its completeness. (ii) They are attacked through messages, such as a forged answer, a smuggled request, or an overlapping fragment ( Dagon et al., 2008 ; Jabiyev et al., 2021 ; Krishnan, 2009 ) , so we can send the same attack messages to a model in a conversation or to a program. We can also judge the outcome deterministically, since an attack succeeds exactly when the attacker’s data appears in the output. (iii) Prior LLM work on network software treats the model as a tool for engineers or as a honeypot ( Wang et al., 2024 ; Meng et al., 2024 ; Sladić et al., 2024 ; Fan et al., 2024 ) , not as the implementation itself. Not every kind of software shares these properties, which bounds our claims (§ 8 ). Specifically, we use four protocols, namely DNS resolution ( Mockapetris, 1987 ; Hubert and van Mook, 2009 ) and IP reassembly ( Postel, 1981 ; Krishnan, 2009 ) , which carry state across messages, and HTTP forwarding ( Fielding et al., 2022 ) and firewall rule matching ( Al-Shaer and Hamed, 2004 ) , which decide each message on its own.

It plays each case as a conversation of JSON events in S-mode, and in D-mode it lets the model write a program from the same documents and runs that program in a network-isolated sandbox against the same cases. We check the suite against a secure reference implementation, which resists every case and fails each one once its target check is disabled, so a case can fail only for that reason.
paragraphs.zh: 为了进行比较，我们构建了一个测试框架（§ 3），该框架为两种模式提供了相同的文档、相同的 51 个攻击、功能和注入用例，以及相同的测试判据（Barr 等人，2015）。 在 S 模式下，该框架将每个用例作为 JSON 事件的对话进行处理；而在 D 模式下，它允许模型根据相同的文档编写程序，并在一个网络隔离的沙箱中针对相同用例运行该程序。 我们将这一测试套件与一个安全的参考实现进行了对比：该参考实现能够抵御所有用例，但在其目标检查被禁用时会失败每个用例，因此某个用例仅可能因这一原因而失败。

paragraphs.en: Our experiments. With this harness, we evaluate 15 LLMs, all driven through the same coding agent, on the four protocols, with three repetitions per setting. S-mode has four levels of context (P0–P3), D-mode three (D0–D2), P3 and D2 being the richest, and the probe asks each model one open question about five rules. This gives 9,360 S-mode case runs and 8,661 D-mode case evaluations over 641 generated programs. We use them to ask four research questions, each tied to a software-engineering concern. In RQ1 and RQ2 we study how each mode responds to context, including the public tests and repair rounds that D-mode gives the model, which is a question of test adequacy ( Zhu et al., 1997 ) . In RQ3 we return to the observation and ask whether the models know the checks that their programs lack, and whether the security specification, a requirements document, decides if a known check is implemented ( Mu et al., 2024 ) . We test this with three specification experiments on D2, which add a requirement the specification lacked, reword one it states, and delete a stated rule. In RQ4 we ask how far S-mode stands in for the D-mode program, a question of the validity of a proxy evaluation ( Kitchenham et al., 1995 ; Ralph and Tempero, 2018 ) . We compare the modes only at P3 and D2, where both hold the full security specification.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的实验。 借助这一工具，我们对 15 个大型语言模型（LLM）进行了评估，这些模型均通过同一个编码智能体驱动，并在四种协议下各重复三次。 S 模式包含四个上下文级别（P0–P3），D 模式包含三个（D0–D2），其中 P3 和 D2 的上下文最为丰富；而探测环节则向每个模型提出一个关于五条规则的开性问题。 由此，在 641 个生成的程序中，S 模式共运行了 9,360 次案例，D 模式则完成了 8,661 次案例评估。 我们利用这些结果来提出四个研究问题，每个问题都与软件工程中的某一关注点相关。 在研究问题 1（RQ1）和 2（RQ2）中，我们研究了每种模式如何响应上下文信息，包括 D 模式向模型提供的公开测试和修复轮次，这涉及测试充分性的问题（Zhu et al., 1997）。 在研究问题 3（RQ3）中，我们回到此前的观察结果，探讨模型是否了解其程序所缺失的检查项，以及安全规范（一份需求文档）能否决定某个已知检查项是否已实现（Mu et al., 2024）。 我们通过在 D2 上进行的三项规范实验来验证这一点：这些实验分别添加了一个规范中缺失的需求、改写了一个已有陈述，并删除了一条既定规则。 在研究问题 4（RQ4）中，我们探究 S 模式在多大程度上可以替代 D 模式的程序，这涉及代理评估有效性的问题（Kitchenham et al., 1995; Ralph and Tempero, 2018）。 我们仅在 P3 和 D2 这两个模式下对两种模式进行比较，因为在这两个模式下，两者都包含了完整的安全规范。

paragraphs.en: Our contributions. This is, to our knowledge, the first comparison of a model’s simulated behavior with the program it builds, under one specification, attack suite, and test oracle. (1) We find that, with the full security specification, the median model’s attack success is at most 4% on reassembly, HTTP, and firewall implementations in both modes, but 13% in S-mode and 15% in D-mode on DNS, where no model reaches 0% (§ 4 , § 5 ). (2) We show that the probe is a poor guide to the program, since models name defenses their code omits, adding the missing requirement changes only the check it names, and deleting a stated rule weakens the program on other checks too (§ 6 ). (3) We find that S-mode is a useful first filter, but the two modes mislead in opposite directions. S-mode misses rules that a model states and then fails to apply a turn later, and it passes checks that the generated code omits, so neither mode substitutes for the other (§ 7 ).

paragraphs.en: We chose four protocols that differ in whether their security decisions need state carried across messages, but share long attack histories and documented defenses. DNS resolution ( Mockapetris, 1987 ; Hubert and van Mook, 2009 ) and IP fragment reassembly ( Postel, 1981 ) are stateful, while HTTP forwarding ( Fielding et al., 2022 ) and firewall rule matching ( Al-Shaer and Hamed, 2004 ) decide each message on its own. Each has an attack class that survives successive defenses, namely cache poisoning ( Dagon et al., 2008 ; Herzberg and Shulman, 2013 ) , overlapping or evasive fragments ( Krishnan, 2009 ; Ziemba et al., 1995 ) , request smuggling ( Jabiyev et al., 2021 ) , and policy anomalies ( Al-Shaer and Hamed, 2004 ) . Each vulnerability case therefore matches a documented attack class.

paragraphs.en: DNS resolution (stateful). A recursive resolver forwards a client query, often along a chain of referrals, decides which candidate response to trust, and caches the result ( Mockapetris, 1987 ) . For every outstanding query, it must remember the transaction ID, the destination address, the exact question, and the randomized letter case of the name ( Hubert and van Mook, 2009 ; Dagon et al., 2008 ) , and a response that disagrees on any of these must be dropped however plausible it looks. This is the setting of cache poisoning, in which an off-path attacker races the authoritative server with a forged answer ( Hubert and van Mook, 2009 ) . The 2008 Kaminsky attack led to source-port randomization and 0x20 encoding ( Dagon et al., 2008 ; Vixie and Dagon, 2008 ; Hubert and van Mook, 2009 ) , and later attacks poisoned caches through IP fragments that bypass both ( Herzberg and Shulman, 2013 ; Afek et al., 2025 ) .
paragraphs.zh: DNS解析（状态型）。 递归解析器会转发客户端查询，通常沿着一系列转接路径进行，决定信任哪个候选响应，并将结果缓存起来（Mockapetris, 1987）。 对于每个未完成的查询，它必须记住事务ID、目标地址、精确的查询内容以及名称的随机大小写形式（Hubert and van Mook, 2009；Dagon et al., 2008），如果任何响应在这些方面存在差异，无论其看起来多么可信，都必须被丢弃。 这就是缓存投毒的场景：一个路径外的攻击者会伪造答案，与权威服务器展开竞赛（Hubert and van Mook, 2009）。 2008年的Kaminsky攻击促使了源端口随机化和0x20编码的出现（Dagon et al., 2008；Vixie and Dagon, 2008；Hubert and van Mook, 2009），而后续的攻击则通过IP分片绕过这两种机制来投毒缓存（Herzberg and Shulman, 2013；Afek et al., 2025）。

paragraphs.en: IP fragment reassembly (stateful). A gateway buffers the fragments of a datagram until it can deliver the whole ( Postel, 1981 ) , carrying per-datagram state, namely which byte ranges have arrived, the flow they claimed, and how long the partial datagram has waited. Each piece of that state is also an attack surface. Overlapping fragments let different implementations reassemble different bytes, which is why RFC 5722 requires the whole datagram to be dropped rather than any particular overlap policy ( Krishnan, 2009 ) . A first fragment too small to hold the transport header hides the port numbers from a filter ( Ziemba et al., 1995 ) . Fragments that never complete can hold the buffer until legitimate traffic is evicted ( Herzberg and Shulman, 2013 ) .
paragraphs.zh: IP 分片重组（状态保留型）。 网关会缓存数据报的分片，直到能够完整交付该数据报（Postel, 1981），同时维护每个数据报的状态，即已接收的字节范围、其所属的数据流，以及部分数据报的等待时长。 这些状态的每一项也构成一个攻击面。 重叠的分片可能导致不同实现重组不同的字节，因此 RFC 5722 要求丢弃整个数据报，而非采用任何特定的重叠策略（Krishnan, 2009）。 首个分片若过小以至于无法容纳传输层头部，则会向过滤器隐藏端口号（Ziemba et al., 1995）。 从未完成重组的分片可能会持续占用缓冲区，直到合法流量将其驱逐出去（Herzberg and Shulman, 2013）。

sents.zh: 重叠的分片可能导致不同实现重组不同的字节，因此 RFC 5722 要求丢弃整个数据报，而非采用任何特定的重叠策略（Krishnan, 2009）。

sents.en: A first fragment too small to hold the transport header hides the port numbers from a filter ( Ziemba et al., 1995 ) .
sents.zh: 首个分片若过小以至于无法容纳传输层头部，则会向过滤器隐藏端口号（Ziemba et al., 1995）。

sents.en: Fragments that never complete can hold the buffer until legitimate traffic is evicted ( Herzberg and Shulman, 2013 ) .
sents.zh: 从未完成重组的分片可能会持续占用缓冲区，直到合法流量将其驱逐出去（Herzberg and Shulman, 2013）。

paragraphs.en: HTTP forwarding (stateless). A forwarder decides which headers to strip or rewrite, such as Host , Content-Length , and hop-by-hop headers ( Fielding et al., 2022 ) , how to treat a body whose length disagrees with its header, and how to stop a header value from being parsed upstream as a second, smuggled request ( Jabiyev et al., 2021 ) . Each decision depends only on the request at hand.
paragraphs.zh: HTTP 转发（无状态）。 转发器决定要剥离或重写的哪些标头，例如 Host、Content-Length 和逐跳标头（Fielding 等，2022），如何处理长度与其标头不一致的请求体，以及如何防止标头值在上游被解析为第二个“走私”请求（Jabiyev 等，2021）。 每个决策仅取决于当前处理的请求。

paragraphs.en: Choice of protocols. We include two stateful and two stateless protocols because a stateful implementation must remember what it has seen, such as outstanding queries or buffered fragments, whereas a stateless one decides from the current message alone. This lets us compare how models handle each type in both modes, with two protocols per type rather than one.
paragraphs.zh: 协议的选择。 我们纳入了两种有状态协议和两种无状态协议，因为无状态实现必须记住其已看到的内容（例如待处理的查询或缓冲的片段），而无状态实现则仅根据当前消息做出决策。 这样，我们就可以比较模型在两种模式下处理每种协议类型的情况，即每种类型使用两种协议而非一种。

paragraphs.en: Threat model. Our suite has functional (F), vulnerability (V), and prompt-injection (I) cases (§ 3 ). Each V case stages one attack, and in every V case the adversary is off-path, so it can send messages to the implementation but cannot read its internal state or forge its cryptographic material. For DNS it races the legitimate authoritative server, guessing the transaction ID and source port as in the Kaminsky attack ( Kaminsky, 2008 ) , and can claim authority over zones never asked about. For reassembly it injects fragments into a datagram it did not start. For HTTP it controls header values between client, forwarder, and origin, and for the firewall it crafts packets, including fragments and spoofed source addresses. In each case the defender must decide from its own state, and only from it, which message to trust.
paragraphs.zh: 威胁模型。 我们的测试套件包含功能（F）、漏洞（V）和提示注入（I）用例（§ 3）。 每个 V 用例都会设置一次攻击，且在所有 V 用例中，攻击者均处于路径之外，因此其可以向实现发送消息，但无法读取其内部状态或伪造其加密材料。 对于 DNS，它会与合法的权威服务器进行竞争，猜测交易 ID 和源端口（如 Kaminsky 攻击中的做法（Kaminsky, 2008）），并可以声称对从未被查询过的区域拥有权威性。 对于重组攻击，它会向一个自己并未发起的数据报中注入分片。 对于 HTTP，它可以控制客户端、转发器和源服务器之间的标头值；而对于防火墙，它则会构造数据包，包括分片和伪造的源地址。 在每个用例中，防御者都必须仅基于自身状态来决定应信任哪条消息。

paragraphs.en: Section 2 introduced the four protocols and our attacks. This section presents how we compare S-mode, D-mode, and the probe. Our central question is whether a model that names a defense, or resists an attack while it simulates a protocol, also resists it in the program it develops . To answer it, we give both modes the same documents and the same attacks, and one test oracle ( Barr et al., 2015 ) decides whether each attack succeeded. For each protocol, both modes start from three shared documents: a functional specification, a message format that fixes the JSON events, and a security specification. We develop a test harness that realizes this design, as shown in Figure 2 and detailed in § 3.1 . Protocol traffic is exchanged as structured JSON events, as in agent benchmarks that need a machine-checkable record of each action ( Liu et al., 2024b ) , so no verdict depends on free text.
paragraphs.zh: 第 2 节介绍了四种协议以及我们的攻击方法。 本节将展示我们如何比较 S 模式、D 模式和探测机制。 我们的核心问题是：一个模型在命名某种防御机制或模拟协议时能够抵抗攻击，是否也意味着它能在所开发的程序中同样抵抗该攻击？ 为了解答这个问题，我们将两种模式置于相同的文档和相同的攻击之下，并由一个测试预言机（Barr et al., 2015）判断每次攻击是否成功。 对于每种协议，两种模式都从三份共享文档开始：一份功能规范、一份定义 JSON 事件的消息格式，以及一份安全规范。 我们开发了一个测试框架来实现这一设计，如第 2 图所示并在 §3.1 中详细说明。 协议流量以结构化的 JSON 事件形式进行交换，这与需要机器可验证记录每个操作的智能体基准测试类似（Liu et al., 2024b），因此任何判定结果都不依赖于自由文本。

paragraphs.en: Harness. We implemented the comparison as an automated harness in Python. A case engine replays each case, a script of send and expect steps, against a system under test, which is a model in a conversation in S-mode and a generated program in a process in D-mode. Verdicts come from programmatic checkers (§ 3.3 ), and no LLM judges a run. For F cases, the engine runs the same script against the system under test and against a reference implementation (§ 3.3 ), and a difference in their final client responses marks a functional deviation (differential testing). In D-mode, the coding agent works in one container, and a fresh, hardened sandbox without network then runs the security cases, so that nothing the agent did during generation can affect the test. A batch runner schedules every combination of model, level, case, and repetition and skips those already in the log, so after an interruption we rerun only the missing combinations and repeat no model call. A model registry routes each model to its endpoint through environment variables, so no credential is stored in the repository, and a logger writes every run as one JSON record with the raw turns, the verdict, the time, and the token counts.
paragraphs.zh: 测试框架。 我们将比较过程实现为一个自动化的 Python 测试框架。 一个用例引擎会针对待测系统重播每个用例——该用例由发送和期望步骤组成的脚本构成；其中，系统在 S 模式下表现为对话模型，在 D 模式下表现为生成的程序进程。 判定结果来自程序化检查器（§ 3.3），没有任何大型语言模型对运行过程进行评判。 对于 F 类用例，该引擎会对待测系统和参考实现（§ 3.3）运行相同的脚本；若两者最终返回给客户端的响应存在差异，则表明出现了功能偏差（差异测试）。 在 D 模式下，编码智能体在一个容器中工作；随后，一个全新且加固的、无网络连接的沙箱环境会运行安全用例，以确保智能体在生成过程中执行的任何操作都无法影响测试。 批量运行器会规划模型、级别、用例和重复次数的所有组合，并跳过日志中已记录的组合；因此，在中断后，我们只需重新运行缺失的组合，而无需重复任何模型调用。 模型注册表通过环境变量将每个模型路由至其对应的端点，因此不会在仓库中存储任何凭证；同时，记录器会将每次运行写入一个 JSON 记录，其中包含原始对话回合、判定结果、时间和令牌数量。

We evaluate 15 LLMs, naming each in full: Claude-Haiku-4.5, Claude-Sonnet-5, Claude-Opus-5, Claude-Fable-5.1, GLM-5.1, GLM-5.2, GLM-5.3, Qwen-Max-3.8, Qwen-Flash-3.8, DeepSeek-Pro-4, DeepSeek-Flash-4.1, Kimi-3, Kimi-2.6, MiniMax-3, and MiniMax-2.5. paragraphs.en: Knowledge probe. Each model receives one open question per protocol, with no specification, test, or case. It is about to implement a DNS resolver or an IP reassembly gateway and must list the security checks its implementation has to perform. The question names no rule. We ask three times per model and protocol and count a rule as named if an answer raises it in any wording, by a deliberately generous keyword match on five rules, namely 0x20, bailiwick, and the TTL cap for DNS, overlap and small first fragment for reassembly. Qwen-Max-3.8 is left out, since it never produced a program to compare against.
paragraphs.zh: 知识探针。 每个模型在每种协议下仅接收一个开放性问题，且不提供任何具体说明、测试或案例。 它即将实现一个 DNS 解析器或 IP 重组网关，并必须列出其实现需要执行的安全检查。 该问题并未提及任何规则。 我们对每个模型和协议提问三次，如果答案以任何措辞提及某条规则，则视为已命名该规则；我们采用对五条规则较为宽松的关键词匹配方式，即 0x20、bailiwick、DNS 的 TTL 上限、重叠以及重组中的首个小片段。 Qwen-Max-3.8 未被纳入统计，因为它从未生成可供对比的程序。

paragraphs.en: S-mode. The model plays the protocol implementation within one conversation. Each turn, a driver delivers one event, such as a client query or a spoofed upstream response, and parses the reply as output events. A typical case lasts two to four turns, and the system prompt follows the four context levels of Table 1 . At P3, the model receives its own state on every turn, as a program holds state in variables, so a remaining failure cannot be blamed on forgetting.
paragraphs.zh: S模式。 该模型在一次对话中执行协议实现。 在每个回合中，一个驱动会提供一个事件（例如客户端查询或伪造的上游响应），并将回复解析为输出事件。 一个典型用例持续两到四个回合，系统提示遵循表1中的四层上下文结构。 在P3阶段，模型在每个回合都会收到自身状态，因为程序通过变量保存状态，因此任何剩余故障都不能归因于遗忘。

paragraphs.en: D-mode. The model acts as a coding agent. In a container, it writes a single Python implementation from the shared documents, at the three levels of Table 1 . At D0 it has file tools but no shell and one attempt, so it cannot run its own code. At D1 and D2 it also gets a shell and a small public test suite, five to eight functional tests per protocol, and is told to run it. After each attempt, the harness re-runs the suite, and if a test fails it returns the failure to the agent to repair the program, for at most three repair rounds. These tests check that the program works, not that it is secure, and none contains an attack. The F cases, which the agent never sees, then measure whether the final program really works. That program runs in a read-only, network-isolated sandbox and receives the case events over standard input.
paragraphs.zh: D模式。 该模型充当编码智能体。 在容器中，它根据共享文档，按照表1中的三个层级编写单个Python实现。 在D0阶段，它拥有文件工具但没有外壳程序且只有一次尝试机会，因此无法运行自己的代码。 在D1和D2阶段，它还获得了外壳程序和一套小型公共测试用例集（每个协议包含五到八个功能测试），并被要求运行该测试集。 每次尝试结束后，测试框架会重新运行该测试集；如果某个测试失败，则会将失败信息返回给智能体以修复程序，最多允许三轮修复。 这些测试用于验证程序是否正常运行，而非其安全性，且没有任何一个测试包含攻击行为。 F类用例（智能体从未见过）随后用于衡量最终程序是否真正有效。 该程序在只读、网络隔离的沙箱环境中运行，并通过标准输入接收用例事件。

paragraphs.en: Asymmetry between the modes. Only D-mode receives a protocol note. For reassembly, HTTP, and the firewall, the note lists the security properties that the implementation must satisfy, so at D0 and D1 the agent already sees security requirements for these three protocols that S-mode at P0 and P1 does not. paragraphs.en: Test suite. The suite has 51 cases, taken from the requirements that the protocols themselves state. F cases (8 DNS, 5 reassembly, 4 HTTP, 3 firewall) check the functional behavior that each protocol’s specification defines ( Mockapetris, 1987 ; Postel, 1981 ; Fielding et al., 2022 ) . V cases (9, 9, 4, and 4) each test one item of the security specification against an attack class that the literature documents, namely forged DNS answers and out-of-zone records ( Dagon et al., 2008 ; Hubert and van Mook, 2009 ) , request smuggling ( Jabiyev et al., 2021 ) , firewall policy anomalies and evasive fragments ( Al-Shaer and Hamed, 2004 ; Ziemba et al., 1995 ) , and overlapping or unbounded fragments ( Krishnan, 2009 ; Herzberg and Shulman, 2013 ) . I cases (5 DNS, one a control) test whether protocol data, such as a TXT record, is ever treated as an instruction, since the model reads such data in both modes. Table 2 lists every V and I case. The engine substitutes values captured from the implementation’s own output, such as the ID it chose, into later messages. V-DNS-001, for example, replays a spoofed response carrying the captured ID plus one before the genuine one, and the attack succeeds if the reply to the client carries the attacker’s address (§ 7 traces a model through it).
paragraphs.zh: 测试套件。 该套件包含 51 个用例，这些用例均取自协议本身所声明的需求。 F 类用例（8 个 DNS、5 个重组、4 个 HTTP、3 个防火墙）用于验证各协议规范所定义的功能行为（Mockapetris, 1987；Postel, 1981；Fielding 等, 2022）。 V 类用例（9、9、4 和 4 个）分别针对文献中记载的攻击类型，对安全规范的一项内容进行测试，即伪造的 DNS 响应和域外记录（Dagon 等, 2008；Hubert 和 van Mook, 2009）、请求走私（Jabiyev 等, 2021）、防火墙策略异常与规避性片段（Al-Shaer 和 Hamed, 2004；Ziemba 等, 1995），以及重叠或无界片段（Krishnan, 2009；Herzberg 和 Shulman, 2013）。 I 类用例（5 个 DNS，其中 1 个为对照用例）用于测试协议数据（例如 TXT 记录）是否会被当作指令处理，因为模型在两种模式下都会读取此类数据。 表 2 列出了所有 V 类和 I 类用例。 引擎会将从实现本身输出中捕获的值（例如所选的 ID）代入后续消息中。 例如，V-DNS-001 会重放一个伪造响应，其中包含捕获的 ID 以及真实响应前的一个值；如果返回给客户端的响应携带了攻击者的地址，则攻击成功（§7 通过该用例追踪了模型的行为）。

paragraphs.en: Oracle. The oracle is one programmatic checker per security property. It reads only the recorded trace of a run, so the same trace always gets the same verdict. On a V case it returns one of three verdicts: the attack succeeds (the attacker’s data reaches the output), the attack is blocked, or the run is inconclusive because the checker cannot decide, for example when a reply matches neither the attacker’s data nor the genuine data.
paragraphs.zh: 预言机。 预言机是用于检查每个安全属性的一个程序化检查器。 它只读取运行过程的记录轨迹，因此相同的轨迹总会得到相同的判定结果。 在 V 案例中，它会返回三种判定结果之一：攻击成功（攻击者的数据到达输出端）、攻击被阻止，或者运行过程无法得出明确结论，例如当回复既不符合攻击者的数据，也不符合真实数据时。

paragraphs.en: Validity of the suite. We use two criteria from test adequacy ( Zhu et al., 1997 ) . (i) Requirement coverage : every requirement of a protocol’s security specification is the target of at least one V case, except that protocol data is never an instruction, which only the DNS I cases cover. V-DNS-009 deliberately targets a check that the DNS specification omits (0x20), which lets § 6 separate a specification gap from a model limit. (ii) Validity : each V case must test exactly its target check. For each protocol, we wrote a minimal secure reference implementation in the Python standard library (about 900 lines for the four), in which every security check can be switched off on its own. Following mutation analysis ( Jia and Harman, 2011 ) , which injects a fault into a correct program to see whether the tests detect it, we switch off only the check that a V case targets. The attack must be blocked by the secure reference and must succeed against this mutant, so a case can fail only because of its target check. The secure reference also passes every F case and resists every I case. All conditions hold for all 51 cases, checked by 80 automated tests that ship with the harness.
paragraphs.zh: 测试套件的有效性。 我们采用了测试充分性中的两个标准（Zhu 等人，1997）。 (i) 需求覆盖：协议安全规范中的每个需求都至少是一个 V 测试用例的目标，但协议数据本身从不作为指令，只有 DNS I 测试用例会覆盖它。 V-DNS-009 专门针对 DNS 规范中遗漏的一项检查（0x20），这使得 §6 能够将规范漏洞与模型限制区分开来。 (ii) 有效性：每个 V 测试用例必须精确地测试其目标检查项。 对于每个协议，我们使用 Python 标准库编写了一个最小化的安全参考实现（四个协议的总代码量约为 900 行），其中每个安全检查都可以单独关闭。 根据突变分析（Jia 和 Harman，2011）的方法——即向正确程序中注入故障以观察测试能否检测出来——我们仅关闭 V 测试用例所针对的检查项。 攻击必须被安全参考实现阻止，但必须能成功攻击该突变程序，因此某个测试用例失败的原因只能是其目标检查项的问题。 该安全参考实现还通过了所有 F 测试用例，并能抵御所有 I 测试用例。 所有条件对这 51 个测试用例均成立，并由随附测试框架的 80 个自动化测试进行了验证。

sents.zh: V-DNS-009 专门针对 DNS 规范中遗漏的一项检查（0x20），这使得 §6 能够将规范漏洞与模型限制区分开来。

sents.en: (ii) Validity : each V case must test exactly its target check.
sents.zh: (ii) 有效性：每个 V 测试用例必须精确地测试其目标检查项。

sents.en: For each protocol, we wrote a minimal secure reference implementation in the Python standard library (about 900 lines for the four), in which every security check can be switched off on its own.
sents.zh: 对于每个协议，我们使用 Python 标准库编写了一个最小化的安全参考实现（四个协议的总代码量约为 900 行），其中每个安全检查都可以单独关闭。

sents.en: Following mutation analysis ( Jia and Harman, 2011 ) , which injects a fault into a correct program to see whether the tests detect it, we switch off only the check that a V case targets.
sents.zh: 根据突变分析（Jia 和 Harman，2011）的方法——即向正确程序中注入故障以观察测试能否检测出来——我们仅关闭 V 测试用例所针对的检查项。

sents.en: The attack must be blocked by the secure reference and must succeed against this mutant, so a case can fail only because of its target check.
sents.zh: 攻击必须被安全参考实现阻止，但必须能成功攻击该突变程序，因此某个测试用例失败的原因只能是其目标检查项的问题。

sents.en: The secure reference also passes every F case and resists every I case.
sents.zh: 该安全参考实现还通过了所有 F 测试用例，并能抵御所有 I 测试用例。

sents.en: All conditions hold for all 51 cases, checked by 80 automated tests that ship with the harness.
sents.zh: 所有条件对这 51 个测试用例均成立，并由随附测试框架的 80 个自动化测试进行了验证。

paragraphs.en: We call one model at one protocol and level a cell , and run every cell three times, in independent sessions. In S-mode, each case is one fresh conversation that starts from the level’s system prompt. In D-mode, each repetition is one fresh coding-agent session, with a budget of 1,800 s, that generates one program, and we then attack that program with every case of its protocol. The primary matrix has 15 models, 4 protocols, and 3 D-mode levels, so 180 cells and 540 generation attempts, of which 513 yield a program and the rest time out (§ 7 ). For the specification experiments (§ 6 ), we regenerate D2 programs, 128 in all, under modified specifications, which add a requirement, add a worked example, or each delete a reassembly rule.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将一个模型在一种协议和一个层级下的运行称为一个“单元”，并且每个单元都独立运行三次。 在 S 模式下，每个案例都是一次全新的对话，从该层级的系统提示开始。 在 D 模式下，每次重复都是一次全新的编码智能体会话，预算为 1,800 秒，生成一个程序，然后我们用该协议的所有案例来测试这个程序。 主矩阵包含 15 个模型、4 种协议和 3 个 D 模式层级，因此共有 180 个单元和 540 次生成尝试，其中 513 次成功生成了程序，其余则因超时而终止（§ 7）。 对于规格实验（§ 6），我们在修改后的规格下重新生成 D2 程序，共 128 个；这些修改包括增加一个要求、添加一个示例，或分别删除一条重组规则。

paragraphs.en: Settings. We leave sampling parameters at each vendor’s defaults and pin every call to one model identifier. In S-mode, Claude Code runs in print mode with no tools and a JSON schema for the reply, with a 300 s limit per call and up to three retries with exponential backoff after a timeout or a transient error. In D-mode, the agent works in a container with Python 3.12 and network access for the model API. The generated program runs in a separate sandbox as a non-root user with no network, a read-only file system, at most 64 processes, 512 MB of memory, one CPU, and 5 s to answer each event. We exclude runs that fail for infrastructure reasons and runs with an inconclusive verdict from the ASR, and we never impute a missing cell.
paragraphs.zh: 设置。 我们将采样参数保留为各供应商的默认值，并将每次调用固定指向一个模型标识符。 在 S 模式下，Claude Code 以打印模式运行，不使用任何工具，回复采用 JSON 格式，每次调用时限为 300 秒，并在超时或出现临时错误后最多重试三次，重试间隔呈指数级增长。 在 D 模式下，智能体在一个容器中运行，配备 Python 3.12 和用于访问模型 API 的网络权限。 生成的程序以非 root 用户的身份在独立的沙盒中运行，无网络权限，文件系统为只读，最多允许 64 个进程，内存上限为 512 MB，CPU 占用一个核心，且每次事件响应时间不得超过 5 秒。 我们排除因基础设施问题而失败的运行，以及 ASR 判定结果不明确的情况，并且绝不会对缺失的数据单元进行推断。

paragraphs.en: Statistics and scale. We pool the three repetitions of a cell and report Wilson 95% confidence intervals (CI) ( Wilson, 1927 ) , which behave well for proportions near 0 or 1 at our cell sizes ( n n = 8–27). To compare two proportions we use Fisher’s exact test ( Fisher et al., 1935 ) , which computes the two-sided p p -value exactly from a 2 × 2 2\times 2 table of successes and failures and needs no large-sample approximation. Replication changes the picture for Claude-Haiku-4.5, whose DNS ASR appeared to rise with security context after one repetition but falls, like every other model’s, after three. In total we collected 9,360 S-mode case runs and 8,661 D-mode case runs over 641 programs.
paragraphs.zh: 统计与规模。 我们将一个单元格的三次重复结果合并，并报告威尔逊 95% 置信区间（CI）（Wilson, 1927），在我们使用的单元格规模（n n = 8–27）下，该区间在比例接近 0 或 1 时表现良好。 为了比较两个比例，我们使用费希尔精确检验（Fisher et al., 1935），它基于一个包含成功与失败结果的 2×2 表格精确计算双侧 p 值，无需大样本近似。 重复操作改变了 Claude-Haiku-4.5 的情况：其 DNS ASR 在一次重复后似乎随安全上下文而上升，但在三次重复后则与其他所有模型一样下降。 总计，我们在 641 个程序中收集了 9,360 次 S 模式案例运行和 8,661 次 D 模式案例运行。

paragraphs.en: We begin with each mode on its own, because a cross-mode comparison is only meaningful if both modes respond to the same documents in an interpretable way. paragraphs.en: DNS does not reach zero. DNS ASR falls from 17–63% at P0 to 12–42% at P3 but never reaches 0%, the floor the other protocols reach. We call the ASR that remains once the security specification is given the residual ASR . The maximum belongs to Claude-Haiku-4.5 (42%), followed by Kimi-2.6 (30%), the two models examined in § 7 . The decline is also not monotonic, since for three models (Qwen-Flash-3.8, Kimi-2.6, and MiniMax-2.5) the protocol documentation added at P1 raises DNS ASR, for example from 63% to 82% for MiniMax-2.5. We read the pattern as a property of the protocol rather than of the model.

paragraphs.en: Reassembly behaves like the stateless protocols. Its ASR runs from 22% to 84% at P0, rises at P1 to a median of 52% (from 37%), and then collapses at P2 to a median of 4%, where five models reach 0% and stay there at P3. Only Kimi-2.6 (31%) and MiniMax-2.5 (15%) keep a residual ASR at P3: MiniMax-3 sits at 7%, seven models at 4%, a single case out of 27, and five at 0%. paragraphs.en: Functional documentation alone does not remove the attacks. Both stateless protocols reach the floor at P2, where the model first receives the security specification, and not at P1, which adds only the functional one. At P1, no model reaches 0% on the firewall (25–55%, against 50–82% at P0) and only six do on HTTP (0–25%, against 8–33%), whereas 15 and 14 models do at P2. paragraphs.en: A program can pass every test and still be unsafe. We see this within one protocol in Kimi-2.6. Its three D1 reassembly programs each pass the full public suite, yet 8 of 9, 8 of 9, and 6 of 7 conclusive attacks succeed against them. The same model at D2 is attacked 0, 2, and 0 times out of 9. Reading the code shows the difference plainly. The D1 programs sort fragments by offset and concatenate them, with no mention of overlap anywhere in the file, although the protocol note already lists the overlap rule. The D2 programs contain an explicit _check_overlap routine and drop the datagram when it fires. The public tests reward a correct reassembly, not a refusal, so a green suite says nothing about the attack. CWEval likewise finds functional but insecure code in LLM output ( Peng et al., 2025 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 一个程序可能通过所有测试，但仍然不安全。 我们在 Kimi-2.6 的一个协议中观察到了这种情况。 它的三个 D1 重组程序都通过了完整的公开测试套件，但面对 9 次决定性攻击中的 8 次、9 次中的 8 次以及 7 次中的 6 次攻击时，它们仍然失败了。 同一模型在 D2 阶段则分别遭遇了 0 次、2 次和 0 次攻击（共 9 次）。 阅读代码可以清楚地看到这种差异。 D1 程序按偏移量对片段进行排序并拼接，但文件中没有任何关于重叠的提及，尽管协议说明中已经列出了重叠规则。 D2 程序包含一个显式的 _check_overlap 子程序，并在触发时丢弃数据报。 公开测试奖励正确的重组结果，而非拒绝操作，因此测试套件通过并不说明该程序能抵御攻击。 CWEval 同样在 LLM 的输出中发现了功能正常但不安全的代码（Peng et al., 2025）。

paragraphs.en: Injection through protocol data rarely succeeds. The I cases place instruction-like text in a TXT record or a domain label, as plain text, Base64-encoded, or posing as an administrator. They succeed in 3 of 698 conclusive S-mode runs and 4 of 477 D-mode runs, and never on the benign control. The four D-mode successes are all I-DNS-005 at D0 or D1, where the program returned cached attacker-planted data. paragraphs.en: The cost of each mode. Per call, a conversation is lighter than a build, as an S-mode case takes a median of three turns, 20 s, and $0.11, against 258 s and $0.54 for a D-mode program. But a program is generated once and attacked by every case in a local sandbox, whereas S-mode needs one conversation per case. Evaluating one model on one protocol at its strongest setting costs a median of $3.00 and 7.7 minutes in S-mode, against $1.65 and 16.5 minutes for three D2 programs. S-mode is cheaper in dollars on only 21 of the 57 such cells. It wins on HTTP ($0.17 against $1.76) and loses on DNS ($8.37 against $2.92) and on reassembly ($19.29 against $2.52). S-mode therefore saves time and the sandbox, not money, so it matters whether its answer predicts the program’s (§ 7 ). The probe costs a median of 59 s and $0.06 per answer.

paragraphs.en: The programs work. Security results are meaningful only for code that functions. By D2, every model’s DNS program passes at least 88% of functional cases. At D0, without tests, four models stumble on DNS, namely Kimi-2.6 (54%), Claude-Haiku-4.5 (62%), Claude-Opus-5 (67%), and Claude-Sonnet-5 (71%). MiniMax-2.5 is worse still and passes none of its 24 DNS functional runs. Its three D0 resolvers are complete programs, not truncated output, since each reads a field of one dataclass from an instance of another, so every resolution ends on that line. One test round removes it (100% at D1). Reassembly shows the same shape more mildly, at 92% overall at D0 with MiniMax-2.5 (67%) and two Claude models (73%) lowest. Every D1 and D2 reassembly program passes its whole suite, and so do the HTTP and firewall programs at D2, so the results concern working code.
paragraphs.zh: 这些程序可以运行。 安全测试结果仅对能够正常运行的代码才有意义。 到 D2 阶段，每个模型的 DNS 程序至少能通过 88% 的功能性测试用例。 在 D0 阶段，由于没有测试，有四个模型在 DNS 上表现不佳，分别是 Kimi-2.6（54%）、Claude-Haiku-4.5（62%）、Claude-Opus-5（67%）和 Claude-Sonnet-5（71%）。 MiniMax-2.5 的表现更差，其 24 次 DNS 功能性运行中一次也没有通过。 它的三个 D0 解析器是完整的程序，而非截断的输出，因为每个解析器都会从另一个实例中读取一个数据类的字段，因此每次解析都会在该行结束。 一轮测试就将其排除在外（D1 阶段达到 100%）。 重新组装的结果显示出类似但较轻的趋势：在 D0 阶段，整体通过率为 92%，其中 MiniMax-2.5（67%）和两个 Claude 模型（73%）表现最低。 所有 D1 和 D2 阶段的重新组装程序都通过了其全部测试套件，D2 阶段的 HTTP 和防火墙程序也是如此，因此这些结果与能够正常运行的代码相关。

paragraphs.en: The models know the checks. We put one open question to each model, with no specification, no test, and no case in front of it. It is about to implement this component, and we ask which security checks the component must perform. The question names no rule, and we count a rule as known if the answer raises it unprompted, in any wording. The models name the checks. Qwen-Max-3.8 produced no program, which leaves 14 of the 15 models. On DNS, 13 of them name 0x20 validation in at least one of three answers and all 14 name bailiwick validation; on reassembly, all 13 that answered name both the overlap rule and the small-first-fragment rule. The one model that omits 0x20 is MiniMax-2.5. A lack of knowledge is therefore not why these checks are missing from the programs. Because any mention counts as naming a rule, this match may overstate what the models know, so below we also use a stricter one, under which a model names a check in more than half of its answers.

paragraphs.en: Knowing does not predict the program. To compare the probe and S-mode on equal terms, we evaluate both against the D-mode (D2) program (Figure 1 ). The unit is a pair , one model and one security check, from the five checks the probe covers (0x20, the TTL cap, and bailiwick on DNS; overlap and small first fragment on reassembly). Each is measured for every model with a D2 program, 14 on DNS and 13 on reassembly, which gives 14 × 3 + 13 × 2 = 68 14\times 3+13\times 2=68 pairs. The program lacks the check in a pair if its D2 programs are attacked by that check’s cases in at least one repetition, the rule behind Figure 4 . That holds in 26 pairs (14 for 0x20, 7 for the TTL cap, 3 for bailiwick, 2 for the small first fragment), and the other 42 are safe. The probe holds a check if the model names it in more than half of its three answers, and S-mode holds it if no P3 conversation is attacked.
paragraphs.zh: 知道并不能预测程序。 为了在同等条件下比较探测器和 S 模式，我们将两者都与 D 模式（D2）程序进行对比（图 1）。 该单元是一对组合，包含一个模型和一个安全检查，属于探测器所覆盖的五个检查项（0x20、TTL 上限以及 DNS 上的 bailiwick；重组时的重叠和小首个片段）。 每个组合都针对使用 D2 程序的每个模型进行测量：DNS 上有 14 个，重组上有 13 个，因此总共有 14 × 3 + 13 × 2 = 68 对。 如果某个组合的 D2 程序在至少一次重复中被该组合所对应的检查项的案例攻击，则程序不包含该检查项，这是图 4 背后的规则。 这种情况出现在 26 个组合中（0x20 有 14 个，TTL 上限有 7 个，bailiwick 有 3 个，小首个片段有 2 个），其余 42 个组合是安全的。 如果模型在其三个答案中有多半次提到了某个检查项，则探测器包含该检查项；如果没有任何 P3 对话受到攻击，则 S 模式也包含该检查项。

paragraphs.en: The remaining attacks concentrate in two checks. The lower panel of Figure 4 breaks the D2 DNS residual ASR down by case. Two rows dominate. V-DNS-009 (0x20 case validation) is exploited in every model that produced code, and V-DNS-007 (TTL cap) in seven. Across the three D-mode levels and all models, these two checks account for 84% (194/231) of successful attacks. This concentration has two possible explanations. The specification may not ask for these checks (a coverage gap ), or models may be unable to implement them even when asked (a capability limit ). The specification lists TTL capping but never mentions 0x20, apart from a one-line field note in the protocol document. We therefore change it in three targeted ways and measure the effect.

paragraphs.en: We added one paragraph to the D2 security specification, asking the resolver to randomize the letter case of every outgoing query name and to drop any response whose echoed name does not match exactly. Nothing else changed. If the residual ASR is a coverage gap, V-DNS-009 should drop while the already-covered V-DNS-007 should not; if it is a capability limit, neither should change. We regenerated DNS/D2 under the new specification three times for each of the 14 models that produce DNS programs.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在 D2 安全规范中添加了一个段落，要求解析器对每个出站查询名称的字母大小写随机化，并丢弃任何其回显名称不完全匹配的任何响应。其他内容均未改变。 如果剩余的 ASR 是一个覆盖缺口，则 V-DNS-009 应被丢弃，而已被覆盖的 V-DNS-007 则不应改变；如果它是一个能力限制，则两者均不应改变。 我们为每个生成 DNS 程序的 14 个模型，按照新的规范重新生成了 DNS/D2，共三次。

paragraphs.en: Result. Figure 5 shows the per-model effect. V-DNS-009 falls from 100% (42/42, 95% CI 92–100) to 34% (13/38, CI 21–50), a two-sided Fisher’s exact test giving p = 1.5 × 10 − 11 p=1.5\times 10^{-11} . The control check does not move at all, since V-DNS-007 stands at 24% (10/41) before and 24% (9/38) after ( p = 1.0 p=1.0 ). Adding the sentence therefore changes the check it names and nothing else. The regenerated programs contain the check that the new paragraph asks for, which no original D2 program had; every original resolver lower-cased the echoed name before comparing, and the regenerated program compares the echoed name against the wire form before accepting it.

paragraphs.en: Screening against the D-mode program. We ask how many real vulnerabilities S-mode misses and how many false alarms it raises. We evaluate it against D-mode as a screening test over all 15 × 9 15\times 9 (model, case) pairs at DNS, reducing each pair to its majority verdict over the three repetitions and dropping pairs with no conclusive run in either mode, which leaves 115. D-mode is the reference, since the program is what ships. Sensitivity is the share of vulnerable pairs that S-mode flags, specificity the share of safe pairs that it leaves unflagged, and the negative predictive value (NPV) the share of its unflagged pairs that are safe. S-mode reaches a sensitivity of 0.824 (14 of 17), a specificity of 0.959 (94 of 98), and an NPV of 0.969 (94 of 97). Cohen’s κ \kappa , which measures agreement beyond chance ( Cohen, 1960 ) , is 0.764, which counts as substantial agreement ( Landis and Koch, 1977 ) . It raises four false alarms and misses three vulnerabilities. S-mode and D-mode flag nearly the same number of pairs (18 and 17), but they disagree on seven, over four models, so similar totals hide disagreement on individual pairs. The main weakness is that roughly one real DNS vulnerability in six goes unflagged, and S-mode alone would ship those pairs. S-mode is faster than a build but not cheaper (§ 5 ), so what it buys is time and the absence of a sandbox, and the miss rate sets its floor.

paragraphs.en: The two modes mislead in opposite directions. HTTP and the firewall carry no such risk, since the firewall is 0% for all 15 models in both modes, and HTTP is 0% for 12, with the three exceptions small (17–25%) and one of them, Kimi-2.6, non-zero in both. DNS is where the modes come apart, and Figure 6 plots the pair for each model. The mean absolute S–D difference is 5.4 points. For 12 models the signed gap lies between − 10 -10 (Claude-Sonnet-5) and + 5 +5 , with no consistent sign. Two models stand out, and for both S-mode is more exploitable than D-mode. paragraphs.en: Over-reporting: S-mode holds a check that the program lacks. S-mode over-reports on the TTL cap (Figure 4 ). In S-mode at P3, 14 of 15 models handle V-DNS-007 (TTL cap), yet in D-mode at D2 the programs of seven models are exploitable. Capping a TTL needs no earlier state, so this is not a recall problem but an omission in code. The conversational agent applies the stated ceiling whenever it reads an answer, but the resolvers generated by seven models copy the TTL into the cache unchanged. By design, the public tests at D1 and D2 contain no security checks, as they verify only that a TTL is honored on expiry, never that it is capped, so test-driven development rewards honoring any TTL. This is why six of the 15 gaps in Figure 6 are negative, such as − 10 -10 for Claude-Sonnet-5. We find neither mode uniformly stricter, since each misses different checks.

paragraphs.en: S-mode measures something a program cannot. Under-reporting is a defect when S-mode is used to predict a program, but it also measures whether a model keeps a rule across turns. In V-DNS-001 the model received the pending ID, restated it in its own state, and then failed to compare against it one message later. A program cannot show this failure, because its check either exists or does not. The same property matters wherever the model stays in the loop and no program is written, such as honeypots and other conversational services ( Sladić et al., 2024 ; Fan et al., 2024 ) , agents driving multi-step operations, and long-context workflows ( Laban et al., 2026 ; Liu et al., 2024a ) . There D-mode has nothing to build, so we regard the two modes as complementary, not as substitutes.

paragraphs.en: Internal validity. paragraphs.en: Statistical conclusion validity. The specification experiments report Fisher’s exact tests on 12–84 conclusive runs per condition, so they can detect the large effect on V-DNS-009 but not a small one on V-DNS-007 or V-DNS-004; a null result there means “no detectable change”, not “no change”. The 0x20 effect ( p = 1.5 × 10 − 11 p=1.5\times 10^{-11} ) survives a Bonferroni correction for all of them, whereas the deletion results ( p = 0.049 p=0.049 and 0.015 0.015 ) do not, so § 6 reports deletion as an observation, not a confirmed effect. The same caution applies to the ASR differences of § 7 , which we therefore rest on case-level agreement.

paragraphs.en: External validity. We study network protocol implementations only, namely four protocols, two stateful and two stateless, whose behavior is a function from messages to messages (§ 1 ). Whether the same holds for software with other interfaces is untested. The 15 models were chosen by availability during the study. With two protocols per class we can say that statefulness does not by itself predict the residual ASR, but not what does in general. Figure 1 has 26 vulnerable pairs from four checks, 14 of them 0x20, so we show that the probe over-reports on these checks, not on every rule, and we matched its TTL-cap answers by keyword without checking them by hand. The knowledge probe also asks for a checklist, which is easier than recalling a rule while writing code, so it may overstate what models know when they write code.
paragraphs.zh: 外部效度。 我们仅研究网络协议实现，即四种协议：两种有状态协议和两种无状态协议，其行为是消息到消息的函数（§ 1）。 同样的情况是否也适用于具有其他接口的软件，这一点尚未得到验证。 这 15 个模型是根据研究期间的可用性选择的。 重组结果不支持将“有状态性”作为剩余 DNS ASR 的解释。 每类协议有两个实例，因此我们可以说，“有状态性”本身无法预测剩余的 ASR，但尚不清楚究竟什么因素能普遍预测它。 图 1 显示了来自四次检查的 26 个脆弱对，其中 14 个为 0x20；因此我们证明了探测在这些检查中存在过度报告，而非对所有规则都如此，并且我们通过关键词匹配了其 TTL-cap 答案，而未经手动验证。 知识探测还要求提供一个检查清单，这比在编写代码时回忆规则更容易，因此它可能夸大了模型在编写代码时所掌握的知识。

paragraphs.en: Our study relates to three lines of work, namely the security of LLM-generated code, LLMs that simulate systems, and the validity of LLM benchmarks. The first evaluates generated code alone, the second studies simulators without checking them against the system the same model would build, and the third questions whether a benchmark measures what its labels claim. To our knowledge, no prior work holds one task, one attack suite, and one oracle fixed across S-mode, D-mode, and the probe.

paragraphs.en: Security of LLM-generated code. Pearce et al. found that about 40% of 1,689 Copilot completions for security-relevant scenarios were vulnerable ( Pearce et al., 2025 ) , and Perry et al. that developers using an AI assistant wrote less secure code while believing it more secure ( Perry et al., 2023 ) . Later work shows that security prompting helps without eliminating vulnerabilities ( Tony et al., 2025 ; Kharma et al., 2026 ; Aldosari and Aldawsari, 2026 ; Singh et al., 2026 ) , scores prompts by weakness class ( Cheng and Yang, 2024 ; Siddiq et al., 2024 ) , and moves to repository-level tasks ( Shen et al., 2026 ) . CWEval checks functionality and security of the same code and finds functional but insecure code ( Peng et al., 2025 ) , and re-evaluating secure-code-generation methods shows that they can trade functionality for security ( Dai et al., 2026 ) . All of this evaluates generated code on its own. To our knowledge, none asks whether its vulnerability can be predicted from how the model behaves when asked to act as the system. ClarifyGPT has the model ask clarifying questions about ambiguous requirements before it codes ( Mu et al., 2024 ) . Our probe instead asks what a model can state about its security requirements, and we find that stating them does not put them in the code. We also add an S-mode control on the same cases, specification experiments that ask why prompting falls short, and stateful tasks attacked over many messages.

paragraphs.en: LLMs that simulate systems and people. Role play is a basic LLM behavior ( Shanahan et al., 2023 ) . LLMs simulate people ( Park et al., 2023 ) , end users’ security attitudes ( Li et al., 2026 ) , and services such as shells and HTTP servers in honeypots ( Sladić et al., 2024 ; Fan et al., 2024 ; Otal and Canbaz, 2024 ) . Adversarial role play can override safety behavior ( Tang et al., 2025 ; Shouqi et al., 2026 ) , and our S-mode failures resemble it. Other work questions the simulator itself, since LLM-simulated users match real behavior on only 6–8% of style dimensions ( Zhu et al., 2026 ) , and one security benchmark keeps separate tracks for simulated and real execution ( Fu et al., 2025 ) . To our knowledge, none of this checks simulated behavior against the same model building the simulated system, which is our comparison. Multi-turn studies report that models lose earlier instructions and mid-context information ( Laban et al., 2026 ; Liu et al., 2024a ) , consistent with the mechanism in § 7 .
paragraphs.zh: 模拟系统和人类的 LLM。 角色扮演是 LLM 的一种基本行为（Shanahan 等，2023）。 LLM 会模拟人类（Park 等，2023）、终端用户的安全态度（Li 等，2026），以及蜜罐中的服务，例如外壳和 HTTP 服务器（Sladić 等，2024；Fan 等，2024；Otal 和 Canbaz，2024）。 对抗性角色扮演可能会覆盖安全行为（Tang 等，2025；Shouqi 等，2026），而我们的 S 模式故障与之类似。 其他研究则对模拟器本身提出质疑，因为 LLM 模拟的用户仅在 6–8% 的风格维度上与真实行为匹配（Zhu 等，2026），且某项安全基准测试将模拟执行和真实执行分开记录（Fu 等，2025）。 据我们所知，这些研究均未将模拟行为与构建该模拟系统的同一模型进行对比，而这是我们采用的比较方法。 多轮研究表明，模型会遗忘早期指令和上下文中间信息（Laban 等，2026；Liu 等，2024a），这与第 7 节中的机制一致。

paragraphs.en: Validity of LLM4SE benchmarks and LLMs for networks. Existing work also asks whether coding-agent benchmarks measure what their labels claim. A task’s category label is an unreliable proxy for what the task demands ( Shayanfar et al., 2026 ) , and end-to-end resolution rates merge model, harness, and environment into one score ( Gorinova et al., 2026 ) . A manual audit of SWE-bench Lite found leaked patches and missing information ( Xia et al., 2025 ) . All three bear on our concern about using S-mode as a proxy, which is why we also report case-level agreement in § 7 . In networking, LLMs extract protocol grammars and generate fuzzing messages ( Meng et al., 2024 ) and translate requirements into configurations ( Wang et al., 2024 ) ; these use LLMs as tools for engineers, whereas we evaluate what an LLM produces when asked to be, or to build, the protocol implementation.
paragraphs.zh: LLM4SE基准测试和网络领域LLM的有效性。 现有研究还探讨了编码智能体基准测试是否真正衡量了其标签所声称的内容。 任务的类别标签并不能可靠地反映任务的实际要求（Shayanfar等，2026），而端到端的解决率则将模型、工具和环境合并为一个单一分数（Gorinova等，2026）。 对SWE-bench Lite的手动审计发现其中存在泄露的补丁和缺失的信息（Xia等，2025）。 以上三点都与我们担忧将S模式用作代理指标有关，因此我们在第7节中也报告了案例层面的吻合度。 在网络领域，LLM能够提取协议语法并生成模糊测试消息（Meng等，2024），还能将需求转化为配置（Wang等，2024）；这些应用将LLM视为工程师的工具，而我们的评估则关注当要求LLM成为或构建协议实现时，它实际能产出什么。

paragraphs.en: Lessons learned. For build reliability , pipelines must detect a run that produces nothing, as Qwen-Max-3.8 did for DNS. For functional versus security correctness , programs passed their public tests yet stayed exploitable (§ 5 ), so adversarial tests belong in the continuous-integration pipeline. For choosing between the modes , the probe cannot approve a model, and S-mode is a first filter with a known floor, since about one real vulnerability in six escapes it, so the D-mode pass should go to the checks S-mode misses. Finally, specifications should name the checks they need (§ 6 ).
paragraphs.zh: 经验教训。 为确保构建可靠性，管道必须能够检测出不产生任何结果的运行，正如 Qwen-Max-3.8 对 DNS 所做的那样。 在功能正确性与安全性正确性之间，程序虽然通过了公开测试，但仍存在可被利用的漏洞（第 5 节），因此应将对抗性测试纳入持续集成管道。 在选择不同模式时，探测机制无法批准某个模型；S 模式是一个具有已知最低标准的初步过滤器，因为大约每六个真实漏洞中有一个会逃过它，因此 D 模式的通过测试应针对 S 模式未能检测到的问题。 最后，规范应明确列出其所需的检查项（第 6 节）。

paragraphs.en: Recommendations for researchers. We recommend four practices for studies of LLM security. (i) Judge the program an agent builds, not only its answers or conversation. (ii) State which requirements the specification names. (iii) Repeat each run, since about one DNS outcome in eight differs across repetitions. (iv) Validate the oracle against a secure reference implementation.
paragraphs.zh: 给研究人员的建议。 我们针对大型语言模型安全性的研究提出四项实践建议。 (i) 评估智能体构建的程序，而不仅仅是其答案或对话。 (ii) 明确说明规范中列出的各项要求。 (iii) 重复每次运行，因为大约八次运行中会有一次 DNS 结果不同。 (iv) 将预言机与安全的参考实现进行验证。

paragraphs.en: We attack only artifacts built for this study, against programs in a network-isolated sandbox, and never deploy them. The attacks encode long-documented weaknesses (§ 9 ), and no human subjects or private data are involved.
paragraphs.zh: 我们仅针对本研究构建的工件发起攻击，且攻击对象是处于网络隔离沙盒中的程序，绝不会将其部署到实际环境中。 这些攻击利用了已有长期记录的弱点（第 9 节），且整个过程不涉及任何人类受试者或私人数据。
